description: One monthly reconciliation run for a Client (optionally one Branch Site) over a Timesheet Period. Aggregates the closed period into ONE run that emits TWO sides: client-side Billable Line[] (to invoicing) and worker-side Payable Line[] (to payroll) plus Deduction Candidate[]. The BASIS-CONSISTENT guard halts the run when the two sides disagree on the day-rate basis; threshold application is skipped as a structural no-op for clients with no per-worker feed.

fields.description: Unique run id, e.g. CLIENT-BRANCH-2026-05-v1. This is the record's id and cannot be changed once saved.
fields.label: Run Name

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for a client-wide run.
fields.label: Branch Site

fields.description: The billing / attendance cycle this run reconciles.
fields.label: Period

fields.description: Cutoff date of the run. Drives the P-189 effective-dated rate-card lookup and the per-client handoff SLA (Client Reconciliation Config).
fields.label: Period Cutoff

fields.description: Run version. A correction is a NEW version (reverse + re-run), never an in-place edit.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: State machine: draft to aggregated to rated to thresholds_applied, then either clean to awaiting_approval to posted, or pending_review when a gated / inferred item is open. A correction moves a posted run to reversed.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
draft
aggregated
rated
thresholds_applied
clean
awaiting_approval
posted
pending_review
reversed

fields.description: Open exception / gate flags. Must be 0 before the run may reach posted.
fields.label: Open Flags

fields.description: Sum of the Billable Line amounts (computed at runtime; no VAT here).
fields.label: Total Billable

fields.description: Sum of the Payable Line gross amounts (computed at runtime).
fields.label: Total Payable

fields.description: FED-PRECONDITION snapshot. 1 = the client has a per-worker feed so threshold application runs; 0 = threshold application is skipped as a structural no-op (this run legitimately emits zero Deduction Candidates).
fields.label: Feed Precondition Met

fields.description: Preparer of the run (maker). Must differ from the approver.
fields.label: Prepared By

fields.description: Approver of the POST (checker). Must differ from the preparer.
fields.label: Approved By

fields.description: Audit of which penalty rule fired per worker. A gated / inferred row forces the run to PENDING-REVIEW.
fields.label: Threshold Application Log

name: Reconciliation Run
